remarks: Welcome to 1 Daybreak Commons, a stunning stand-alone residence nestled in the heart of Westport offering a modern lifestyle w/unparalleled convenience. This exquisite home boasts 2 spacious BR's & 3 luxe baths, spread across 3167 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Step inside to discover soaring ceilings that create an open & airy ambiance, complemented by a sophisticated layout that includes an elevator for effortless access to all levels. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream w/high end appliances, over-sized wine chiller & large island for gathering. Enjoy seamless entertaining in the expansive living areas, or retreat to the lovely, landscaped yard & patio for a private, outdoor experience. Stay cool on hot days under the built-in awning. The LL offers an office & family room w/built-in bar & 1/2 bath, perfect for cozy movie nights, a quiet space for work from home days, or overflow entertaining. The over-sized 2 car garage has great storage for all your Costco runs & the stylish mudroom has fab built-ins for coats, supplies, etc. A storage area in the LL rounds out the space you will need for all the items you want hidden away.  This home is part of a 55+ community w/a pet-friendly policy. With its walk-to-town locale & easy access to the Merritt, it is a sanctuary that combines luxury w/convenience, making it the perfect place to call home. Don't miss the opportunity to experience this exceptional lifestyle. Snowbird? Down-sizer? This home is calling!
